messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Severity=P1 | multiple 504/502s and elevated latency affecting hosted-api (us-east-1). Incident created at 1738880000. Automatic war-room created.
Jordan L: ACK. Joining war room now. I'll take owner if no objections. warroom: https://meet.company/room/incident-1738880000 (temp)
Priya M: oncall here. seeing elevated 99th -> ~8s and 504s starting ~1738879800. hitting model-runtime kvcache layer.
Diego R: joining. grabbing logs. Initial glance: kvcache eviction/thrashing and backend RPC queueing.
incident-bot: War room link pinned by Jordan L.
Jordan L: Quick plan: 1) Reduce prefix caching TTL to force fresh cache misses (short term to avoid stale hot cache thrash), 2) scale inference runtime by +30%, 3) enable degraded-mode routing to quantized-compact variants for non-SLA routes, 4) open status page and notify impacted tenants.
Nora K: I'm drafting status page. Proposed: 
"We are investigating intermittent 502/504 errors and increased latency for the Redwood Hosted API in us-east-1. Engineers have identified cache-layer instability and are applying mitigations. Some customers may see failed requests or higher latency. Updates every 15 minutes"
Jordan L: +1. Also prepare a targeted customer note for customers with >5% error increase. Jamie, can you coordinate with AMs?
Jamie C: On it. I'll pull the tenant list (likely: delta-analytics, neon-retail, pilot-dev). I'll draft an email and slack DM the AMs for fast delivery.
Priya M: Running command to scale runtime now: `redwoodctl scale runtime --region us-east-1 --delta +6`
Diego R: Logs snippet from runtime-3: 
```
[2024-07-12T03:40:15Z] WARN kvcache: eviction-ratio 0.82, behind by 140ms
[2024-07-12T03:40:16Z] ERROR rpc: client: write tcp 10.20.30.5:4000->10.20.40.10:6000: i/o timeout
[2024-07-12T03:40:17Z] ERROR batcher: batch queue depth 64, dropping request
```
Jordan L: Diego, please collect pprof and kvcache metrics and push to artifacts. Ops-sre, create S3 bucket for this incident.
ops-sre: Created artifacts path s3://redwood-incidents/1738880000/ (ACL=private). Please upload logs and metrics. Also set retention to 90 days.
Diego R: Uploading logs and kvcache dump now (eta 2m).
Jamie C: Drafted customer message for delta-analytics/neon-retail/pilot-dev: 
"We are investigating intermittent 502/504 errors and high latency in us-east-1 that may affect your API calls. Our engineers have applied scaling and cache mitigations; you may see improved performance. We will follow up with further details and an RCA. If you need immediate assistance please reply to this message or contact your AM."
Jordan L: Send once we confirm scale and routing changes show improvement for 5 minutes. Also label incident: service:hosted-api region:us-east-1 severity:P1 component:kvcache.
Priya M: Scale is in progress, new pods coming up. Running smoke tests on a small traffic slice.
Nora K: Posting status page now and setting update window to 15m: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1738880000 (posted at 1738880105).
Diego R: kvcache dump pushed: s3://redwood-incidents/1738880000/kvcache.dump (1738880122). pprof and metrics at s3://redwood-incidents/1738880000/metrics.tar.gz
Priya M: After scale + temporary TTL bump, initial p95 improved from ~4.8s -> ~0.9s on canary traffic. Error rate dropped from 6.4% -> 1.1% on that slice.
Jamie C: Sending targeted customer notifications now (delta-analytics, neon-retail, pilot-dev). Will CC their AMs.
Jordan L: Good. Prep postmortem placeholder: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1738880000 - I'll own the postmortem. Triage roles: triage lead=Priya M, mitigations=Diego R, comms=Nora K, customer-notices=Jamie C.
ops-sre: Reminder: snapshot control-plane audit logs before any routing toggles. Also tag the incident in tracker: incident-tracker#1738880000.
Diego R: Snapshot complete and uploaded (1738880240). Also noticed some network retransmits on the node; opening a ticket to infra for follow-up.
Priya M: Plan for medium-term: increase kvcache capacity on hot shards, set eviction thresholds higher, and deploy a backpressure fix to batcher. Will create follow-up Jira for infra + runtime teams.
Nora K: Posting leadership update at 1738880300 summarizing impact and mitigations.
Jordan L: Handoff plan: Priya to continue for next 1 hour; if P1 persists, escalate to night SRE and notify execs. I'll remain incident owner and coordinate RCA.
Jamie C: Confirmed customers acknowledged receipt and are monitoring. No escalations yet.
ops-sre: Set severity to P1 and created timeline in tracker. Also scheduled retention export of artifacts.
incident-bot: Status: mitigations applied. Next automated status check in 15m.
Priya M: Adding note: we suppressed long-tail batching and temporarily increased kvcache capacity. Monitoring for regression.
Diego R: Follow-up logs show improved request handling; no new 504s on canary traffic for last 8 mins.
Jordan L: Thanks all. Keep thread updated with any regression or customer escalation. I'll publish a short internal template for exec comms after we stabilize.
Nora K: Publishing internal exec template at 1738880655: 
"Short summary: P1 incident in us-east-1 causing intermittent 502/504 and increased latency related to kvcache instability. Status: mitigations applied (scale + kvcache TTL bump + routing adjustments). Impacted customers notified. Next steps: capacity increase for hot shards and batcher backpressure fix; RCA in progress"
Priya M: Marking timeline when p95 stays <1s for 10m to consider severity downgrade.
ops-sre: Standing by for RCA deep-dive. Keep artifacts uploaded.
incident-bot: Thread auto-note: final update time will set last_message_ts to 1738880745 when closed.
